summary: Iteration 19 cleanup verification: all backend debug endpoints (GET/POST /api/debug/*) return 404, new POST /api/admin/purge-test-devices is password-protected and correctly filters TEST_/test-/diag-/dashboard user_ids, /api/trigger-alert and /api/register-push and legacy /api/status remain functional, and server.py contains 0 references to _last_push_events. Frontend static checks confirm alert.tsx has NO Platform import, showDebug, titleTapsRef, onTitleTap, debugLines, dbg helper, retryLocalSiren, tryStreamingFallback, sirenSource state, or any debug styles. The heading is a plain <Text> (not Pressable), no testID='alert-title', useAudioPlayer(SIREN_SOURCE) is used directly, and app.json expo.version === '1.0.7'. E2E confirms alert screen renders, siren-debug-panel testID is absent from DOM even after 5 taps on the EARTHQUAKE heading, im-safe-btn produces success toast and auto-navigates home, and alert-dismiss-btn returns to home. All 13 pytest tests pass (100%).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 with detail 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' in preview env because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder in /app/backend/.env. DB upsert still succeeds (it runs BEFORE the relay call) but the endpoint responds 500 instead of 201. Not a cleanup regression — a preview-env configuration state. Consider degrading the relay 401 to a warning + 201 so client apps do not see 500 during dev, OR set a real key in preview.

action_items: Optional (not part of this cleanup): reduce /api/register-push failure to a warning + 201 when the Emergent push relay is unreachable, so dev/preview clients don't get a 500 on registration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 223-line file; cleanup was clean — no leftover dead imports, no lingering ring-buffer state, no orphaned helpers.

alert.tsx is 596 lines — starting to approach the 700-line advisory threshold. Consider extracting the GPS-warmup effect and the 'I'm Safe' payload assembly into small hooks/utils in a follow-up if this file grows further.

In /api/register-push, DB upsert happens before push-relay call; the relay failure still raises HTTPException(500) which masks the successful DB write. Consider swallowing the relay error (like send_push does) to keep register idempotent.
seed_data_creation: Test seeds push_devices rows with user_ids TEST_1, test-x, diag-y, dashboard and one unique qg-real-<hex> row. Purge endpoint cleans up test-shaped rows after each class. The qg-real-<hex> row is left behind by design (unique per run) — negligible drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (frontend/.env). ADMIN_TRIGGER_PASSWORD='Pt3481pt' in backend/.env. EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is 'placeholder' in this preview → /api/register-push returns 500 but still upserts DB row before the relay call; treat as env quirk not a bug. Frontend testIDs used: home:'trigger-alert-btn', alert:'alert-screen','im-safe-btn','alert-dismiss-btn','alert-success-toast','alert-error-toast'. Debug panel testID 'siren-debug-panel' is fully removed and should never appear.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing user-facing behavior. The register-push 500 in preview is due to placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY, not a cleanup regression.
